In addition, there are issues with symbolic computation and submatrix construction, which have caused multiple test cases to fail.

MR1、MR3 The failure indicates an error in the symbolic computation of the determinant.

uncertainty: There may be other undetected errors, but the current repair candidates cover the known major issues.
